description:
Area(s) of responsibility
   

  

 Position Title: Senior Network Tech Lead
   

  

 Experience Required: 10\+ years
   

  

 Location: India (Preferred Bangalore, Pune or Noida, but flexible for, Hyderabad, Chennai)
   

  

 Department: Network Practice Delivery
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Network Tech Lead for implementation, troubleshooting and operations of large\-scale enterprise Campus, WAN, and Data Center networks for our customers. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in network implementation \& support, SDN/SD\-WAN platforms (including Velo\-cloud SD\-WAN, Palo Alto, firewalls, Aruba ClearPass, Prima access), and cloud networking (Azure, AWS). The role requires proven project leadership, customer engagement, technical team management, and a strong track record in delivering successful network solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the implementation \& support of robust LAN, WAN, Data Centre, and SDN/SD\-WAN solutions.
* Support Low\-Level Designs (LLD), and technical solution proposals to customers.
* Engage directly with customers to understand requirements and manage technical calls.
* Support project delivery, ensuring successful implementation, issue resolution, and customer satisfaction.
* Implement or migrate the defined design into the production and ensure the smooth cut over or installation of the network.
* Guide and mentor a team of Junior network engineers, driving technical excellence and team development.
* Serve as the technical escalation point (L2/L3\) for complex network issues and critical incidents.
* Define and enforce network documentation standards, maintaining a comprehensive engineering document library.
* Collaborate with OEMs, vendors, and cross\-functional teams for, implementation, integration \& support.
* Execute or Support network migration, integration, and transformation projects, including service recovery and improvement initiatives.
* Document and hand over the implementation, support hyper care.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in network implementation, support, and operations.
* Proven experience leading projects and operations for customer environments.
* Strong fundamentals in Routing \& Switching (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, STP, RSTP, MSTP, VTP, EtherChannel, HSRP, VRRP, VSS, VPC, VDC, FEX, Fabric Path).
* Hands\-on experience architecting and delivering solutions on:
* Primary Skills


  Strong base of Routing \& Switching
   

  

  Velo\-Cloud SDWAN
   

  

  Aruba ClearPass
   

  

  Cisco ISE, DNAC
   

  

* Secondary Skills


  SDN/SD\-WAN platforms (Cisco SD\-WAN)
   

  

  SolarWinds Orion
   

  

* Experience with network security platforms (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA) and network access control.
* Cloud networking expertise: Good to have worked on Azure networking (Vnet, Virtual Network Gateways, Site\-to\-Site IPsec connections, Network Security Group, Virtual network Gateway, Local Network Gateway, Route Tables \& management, etc.). AWS Networking (VPC, Transit gateway, Direct\-connect, CloudWatch, IGW, NAT GW, Security Groups, ALB, NLB, GLB Certificate manager, R53, Multi\-cloud Integrations.
* Certification Requirements:
* CCNA, CCNP or equivalent certification is mandatory.
* Azure AZ\-700, AWS ANS\-C01 or equivalent certification is good to have.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, mentor junior engineers, and manage project delivery.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and customer engagement skills.
* Strong documentation capabilities and process awareness.
* Experience working with vendors and partners on solution implementation support \& troubleshoot.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
